plan.comparison: Only margin loss changes for the same power0/power1 models, folds, seeds, data, optimizer and fixed epoch budget. Power6 excluded because its output cap precludes substantive late learning. Absolute error targets a conditional median; no claim of calibrated expected utility follows.
plan.decision_rule: A candidate is plausible only if both seeds improve pooled out-of-fold MAE by at least 0.005 and each phase has no more than 0.01 regression. Any failing fold is reported. This screen cannot establish final acceptance, recurrence sufficiency or late coverage. If no variant qualifies, do not select the least-bad variant.
plan.epoch_selection: Fixed final epoch; no tuning to held-out training-fold labels.
plan.evaluation: All out-of-fold phase representative predictions retained. Report pooled and per-fold/phase/seat/style gains, training fit and correction magnitude. Do not choose a model from an aggregate concealing late regressions.
plan.loss: Absolute error with unchanged episode/reached-phase weights
plan.purpose: Diagnose output suppression versus public representation using complete training games only. No candidate promotion or policy learning.
